text_block_list.text:
I decided to stop by a shrine with Meisho 
Doto, who had been feeling down.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been feeling well lately, so I'm 
going to go say a little prayer.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll be right back, so...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
All right, monetary offering, monetary 
offering...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Fueeehh!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I accidentally dropped my wallet insideee! 
I-I-I've gotta get it baaaack~!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Kieeeeee! An offering box thief?! Stay 
right where you are!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaaah!! That's not it, that's not it! My 
wallet's inside... My hand?! M-M-My hand 
won't come out...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, finally through—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah-wawaaa~~~!? The world is spinning~~~!!
(Boooooom!!)

Yanking her hand free from the offering 
box sent Meisho Doto tumbling backward 
into a roll, and she slammed right into 
the guardian lion-dog statue...

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
I see, what terrible luck... I'm just glad 
I could return your wallet to you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sho shorry for all the troubllle~! 
Thank you shomuch for finding my wallet, 
tooo!!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, did you pray to the 
sacred tree? I'm sure you'll receive its 
blessing."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll pray for you from the bottom of 
my heart!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-What a magnificent tree. This feels like 
it will bring great blessings!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm always messing up, but I'll do my very 
best, so please, lend me your strength... 
I'm begging you~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Phew... Will this be all right~?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The wind feels lovely, doesn't it? 
...Perhaps my prayer was answered...
choice_data_list:
I'm sure the sacred tree's blessing is 
with you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's true. I feel like a weight 
has been lifted from my heart a bit.

With her spirits lifted, Meisho Doto 
regained her top form!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh...! Please, pretty pleaseeee!!
(THUMP!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ouch... I strained too hard and bumped my 
head—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyowaaah?! At our feet... T-T-There's a 
bunch of weird bugs, noooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Is there no salvation for meee~!

Beset by terrible misfortune from start to 
finish, Meisho Doto was unable to bounce 
back...
